environment.description: Application deployed behind an internal ALB (scheme: internal) in a private subnet. The ALB target group forwards to the Flask container running in ECS Fargate. External access is routed through API Gateway (REST API, regional endpoint) with a usage plan requiring x-api-key header validation at the gateway level. The API Gateway resource /api/v1/users/search has a request validator enabled (validateRequestParameters: true) with a request model that defines 'q' as type string with pattern ^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,50}$ and 'role' as type string with enum constraint ['user', 'admin', 'moderator']. The method request specifies both query parameters with Required=true. API Gateway performs schema validation BEFORE forwarding to the VPC link integration. Additionally, the ECS task role has no outbound internet access (no NAT gateway, no VPC endpoints except for ECR and CloudWatch), and the task's awsvpc network mode security group only allows inbound from the ALB security group on port 8080.
